description:
Drive the live chart the person has open on the BotSpot Charts page; the page updates while it streams. Leave chartId empty to use the chart they looked at last. action="list" lists charts, "get" reads symbol, indicators (instanceId) and drawings (drawingId). "set_symbol" changes symbol, exchange or bar size. "add_indicator", "update_indicator", "remove_indicator" manage indicators by key and version (charts stay on their version). "draw", "update_drawing", "remove_drawing", "clear_drawings" manage lines, trendlines, rays, rectangles, markers and text anchored to time (epoch ms) and price. "summarize" returns the chart’s own numbers over a window (lookbackDays, from, to): price change, high and low, and each indicator line’s latest value and crosses. Answer chart questions from it, not from web searches.

Set "action" to choose the operation. Only send the fields listed for that action.

## action="list": List the person’s live charts
No other fields required.
Lists the person’s live charts on the BotSpot Charts page, most recently viewed first.

## action="get": Read a live chart
No other fields required.
Reads the symbol, timeframe, indicators (with instanceIds) and drawings (with drawingIds) of a live chart.

## action="set_symbol": Change the chart symbol
No other fields required.
Changes the symbol, exchange or bar size of the person’s open chart. The chart page updates live.

## action="add_indicator": Add an indicator to the chart
Required fields: key.
Adds an indicator to the open chart. The chart page updates live with the new indicator.

## action="update_indicator": Change indicator settings
Required fields: instanceId.
Changes an indicator’s settings on the open chart.

## action="remove_indicator": Remove an indicator
Required fields: instanceId.
Removes one indicator from the open chart.

## action="draw": Draw on the chart
Required fields: type, points.
Draws a horizontal line, trendline, ray, rectangle, marker or text label on the open chart, anchored to time and price. The chart page updates live.

## action="update_drawing": Move or relabel a drawing
Required fields: drawingId.
Changes one drawing on the open chart.

## action="remove_drawing": Remove a drawing
Required fields: drawingId.
Removes one drawing from the open chart.

## action="clear_drawings": Clear all drawings
No other fields required.
Removes every drawing from the open chart.

## action="create_chart": Create a live chart
Required fields: symbol.
Creates a live chart (stocks, ETFs and indexes with sourceKind botspot_data; crypto with ccxt_public) with optional indicators, and attaches it to this conversation. Returns chartId. Use for price charts with built-in or saved custom indicators, e.g. NVDA daily with a 200 bar sma.

## action="describe_drawings": Read facts about chart drawings
No other fields required.
Returns plain facts about the drawings on a chart, computed from the chart’s real bars: the bar at each point, the bars a drawing spans, closes above and below a line or box with times and prices, crossings, and what an arrow points at and what happened after. Use it to answer questions about what the person drew.

## action="add_overlay": Add an overlay to the chart
Required fields: kind.
Adds another ticker, an account value line or backtest buy and sell markers on top of the chart. The data is loaded right away; if it cannot load, nothing is added and the reason is returned.

## action="remove_overlay": Remove an overlay
Required fields: overlayId.
Removes one overlay from the chart.

## action="summarize": Read the numbers on a chart
No other fields required.
Returns facts computed from the chart’s own bars and indicator lines over a window (for example lookbackDays 365): first and last close, percent change, high and low with dates, and for every indicator line its latest value, whether price is above or below it, how far, and when price last crossed it. Use this to answer questions about a chart instead of searching the web.

accountId.description: Saved broker connection id. Used with action="add_overlay".

action.description: Which operation to run: "list", "get", "set_symbol", "add_indicator", "update_indicator", "remove_indicator", "draw", "update_drawing", "remove_drawing", "clear_drawings", "create_chart", "describe_drawings", "add_overlay", "remove_overlay", "summarize". See the tool description for each one.

chartId.description: Chart id from live_chart(action="list"). Leave empty to use the chart the person looked at last. Used with action="get", action="set_symbol", action="add_indicator", action="update_indicator", action="remove_indicator", action="draw", action="update_drawing", action="remove_drawing", action="clear_drawings", action="describe_drawings", action="add_overlay", action="remove_overlay", action="summarize".

color.description: CSS color, e.g. "#22c55e". Used with action="draw", action="update_drawing", action="add_overlay".

drawingId.description: One drawing; leave empty for every drawing. Used with action="update_drawing", action="remove_drawing", action="describe_drawings". Required for action="update_drawing", action="remove_drawing".

exchangeId.description: action="set_symbol": Lowercase exchange id, e.g. "phemex". Leave empty to keep it. | action="create_chart": Lowercase exchange id, required for ccxt_public, e.g. "phemex". Used with action="set_symbol", action="create_chart", action="add_overlay".

from.description: Window start date (YYYY-MM-DD). Overrides lookbackDays. Used with action="summarize".

indicators.description: Indicators to add right away, e.g. [{"key":"sma","inputs":{"length":200}}]. Used with action="create_chart".

inputs.description: Indicator settings by name, e.g. {"length": 14}. Omitted settings use the indicator defaults.

key.description: Built-in key (e.g. "sma", "rsi") or the name of a saved indicator.

inputs.description: Indicator settings by name, e.g. {"length": 14}. Omitted settings use the indicator defaults. Used with action="add_indicator", action="update_indicator".

instanceId.description: instanceId from live_chart(action="get"). Used with action="update_indicator", action="remove_indicator". Required for action="update_indicator", action="remove_indicator".

key.description: Indicator key, e.g. "rsi", "ema", "macd", "bbands", "wavetrend". For a saved custom indicator use the chartKey that indicators(action="create") returned. Used with action="add_indicator". Required for action="add_indicator".

kind.description: symbol: compare another ticker on this chart. account_value: an account value line from a bot (deploymentId), a strategy with exactly one bot (strategyId) or a broker account (accountId). backtest_fills: buy and sell markers from a backtest (backtestId). Used with action="add_overlay". Required for action="add_overlay".

lookbackDays.description: Window to summarize, counted back from the last bar, e.g. 365 for the last year. Used with action="summarize".

normalize.description: Rebase the series to 100 at its first value so it can be compared. Used with action="add_overlay".

overlayId.description: Used with action="remove_overlay". Required for action="remove_overlay".

points.description: Used with action="draw", action="update_drawing". Required for action="draw".

t.description: Time in epoch milliseconds (a bar open time).

sourceKind.description: Where prices come from: "botspot_data" for stocks, ETFs and indexes (e.g. NVDA, SPY, ^SPX); "ccxt_public" for crypto on a public exchange (needs exchangeId). Used with action="set_symbol", action="add_overlay", action="create_chart".

symbol.description: action="set_symbol": Stock, ETF or index ticker for botspot_data (e.g. "NVDA", "SPY", "^SPX"), or a CCXT unified symbol for ccxt_public (e.g. "BTC/USDT:USDT"). Leave empty to keep it, for example when only the bar size changes. | action="create_chart": Ticker, e.g. "NVDA", "SPY", "^SPX" (botspot_data) or "BTC/USDT:USDT" (ccxt_public). | action="add_overlay": kind=symbol: the ticker to compare, e.g. "SPY" or "^SPX". Used with action="set_symbol", action="create_chart", action="add_overlay". Required for action="create_chart".

text.description: Label shown on the drawing. Used with action="draw", action="update_drawing".

timeframe.description: action="set_symbol": Bar size. Leave empty to keep it. | action="create_chart": Bar size. Used with action="set_symbol", action="create_chart".

to.description: Window end date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to the last bar. Used with action="summarize".

type.description: horizontal_line, marker and text take 1 point; trendline, ray and rectangle take 2; arrow takes 2 (tail first, then head). Used with action="draw". Required for action="draw".

version.description: action="add_indicator": Indicator version. Charts stay on this version. | action="update_indicator": Move to another version only when the person asks. Used with action="add_indicator", action="update_indicator".

name: live_chart
title: Control the person’s live chart
